description: Fork of exp654 (no resid, out_proj tph=320 dense = 1.4919 @ 86.51M). Trade out_proj tph for sparsity: tph 320 -> 512 (+60% tables), n_sparse=192 (per-table outputs halved from E=384 to 192) with sparse_scatter into E=384 wide output. Per-layer weights 320*64*384=7,864,320 -> 512*64*192=6,291,456 (-1,572,864/layer, -9,437,184 total). Bandwidth 320*384=122,880 -> 512*192=98,304 writes/token (-20%). Expected total params ~77.07M. Tests whether more diverse (sparser) out_proj tables at lower per-table coverage matches or beats the denser, less-table arch. Reference: exp654 = 1.4919 (no resid, tph=320 dense, 86.51M), exp650 = 1.4825 (resid_lut, 86.51M), vanilla SOTA exp328 = 1.3882.
